objective: Phase I: Separate Standalone Node.js Express Backend on Render and Decoupled Next.js Frontend on Vercel with persistent Supabase PostgreSQL and private Storage.
acceptance_criteria: Standalone Node.js + Express backend service under backend/ operating independently from Next.js with zero Next.js runtime imports
100% route contract parity across all 23 API endpoints with matching HTTP methods, status codes, and JSON response shapes
Strict CORS middleware governed by CORS_ORIGINS permitting explicitly configured origins, handling preflight OPTIONS, and blocking unauthorized origins
Dual health endpoints: GET /health/live (process liveness, 200 OK) and GET /health/ready (deep readiness with Supabase probe, safe 503 on dependency failure) with zero secret leakage
Centralized frontend API client src/lib/api-client.ts honoring NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL with trailing slash normalization, non-2xx error handling, and timeout safeguards
Multipart document upload preservation handling up to 5 files and 10MB per file with server-side text extraction
Complete secret isolation: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, and GEMINI_API_KEY reside exclusively on Render; zero database credentials in Vercel frontend
Next.js frontend builds and deploys cleanly to Vercel with old route handlers removed or disabled to prevent duplicate active backends
Standalone backend build (npm run backend:build) and start scripts (npm run backend:start) targeting Node 24 LTS runtime
Comprehensive automated test suites verifying standalone backend HTTP endpoints, health checks, CORS, error handling, and frontend client integration
All 128 existing automated tests continue to pass cleanly without regression
Complete deployment runbook docs/DEPLOYMENT.md and Render blueprint render.yaml
non_goals: Do not add Supabase Auth or require user login, registration, or accounts
Do not break the zero-auth public demo journey or Incognito browser accessibility
Do not expose credentials or database passwords in API responses, client bundles, or logs
Do not execute remote migrations automatically against unknown databases
Do not duplicate business logic across two separate implementations

verification.command: npm test && npm run backend:build && npm run frontend:build
verification.result: 149 of 149 automated tests passed across all 9 test suites (Phase A: 8 tests, Phase B: 9 tests, Phase C: 13 tests, Phase D: 15 tests, Phase E: 23 tests, Phase F: 16 tests, Phase G: 21 tests, Phase H Supabase: 18 tests, Phase I Backend & API: 21 tests). Standalone Express backend compiles to dist/backend/server.js in 14ms. Frontend compiles to Next.js production bundle with 0 errors across all routes. All 23 endpoint contracts preserved, strict CORS verified, health probes verified, centralized frontend API client active, and old Next.js API route handlers disabled.
